citations.review_text:
## Smooth Gameplay, but It Feels Like the Fun Is Slowly Disappearing

FragPunk’s core gameplay is solid. The movement and gunplay feel smooth, matches are fast paced, and the card system gives the game something unique compared to other hero shooters.

Unfortunately, many of the more entertaining cards have been removed or toned down. I understand limiting certain cards in ranked matches for competitive balance, but normal matches should have kept the crazier options. The unpredictable cards were a major part of what made FragPunk feel different and fun.

✅ **Pros**

• Smooth and responsive gameplay
• Unique card system
• Fast paced matches when you find one
• Great battle pass system that never expires after purchase

❌ **Cons**

• Many of the most entertaining cards were removed
• Normal mode feels less creative than it used to
• North American queue times can exceed 10 minutes
• The declining player population makes the game feel abandoned

The battle pass system deserves praise. Once you purchase a pass, you can complete it whenever you want instead of being forced to finish it before a deadline. More live service games should respect players’ time this way.

Overall, FragPunk is still enjoyable when you can actually find a match. The gameplay feels good, but removing so many of the fun cards has weakened its identity. With queue times regularly reaching 10 minutes or longer in North America, I am also concerned that the servers may be slowly dying.

Game has fun mechanics, and characters have cool styles with great abilities. Unfortunate that they don't care about what they created. Its loaded with cheaters, avgs about 500-600 players a day. Game crashes pretty often and queues take about 30-45 mins unless you want to play on asian servers. Don't install it isnt worth it.

As someone with 3000 hours in valorant, I have to say this game got me addicted for a while, sadly there's not enough people in my server playing ranked so queue times were pretty long. I hope more people can find and enjoy this game as much as I did.

Having played for over 500 hours,
Awesome concept and a refreshing addition to FPS games but the insane constant mid rank game crashes and lags despite my hardware just made me to lose the love for this game, which I yet played pretty much everyday till a while ago cus it was just so much fun. 
Plus ranked lobbies after diamond were pretty much dead to me.. queueing for sometimes to not get matches for a whole day or to get a single match filled with sweats. 
As sad as it is, these things made me quit the game.

citations.review_text: It pains my heart to do this. This game is so good. But until the devs realize how ♥♥♥♥♥♥ their matchmaking is, nothing will change. I'm on a generational losing streak right now. 11 games in a row. I'm in Ace. of those 11 games 7 of them i have played with not one teammate above diamond while the other team had 3 Ace's minimum. That shouldn't be possible. I remember in one of the losses a player on my team seriously asked me what a characters ability does. Now that's not in and of itself insane but in an Ace lobby, the second highest competitive tier in the game it should not be possible. This game is so good, and it breaks my heart that competitive becomes unfun after getting to the higher ranks.
